title: Overload
notes: Overload (X) is the printed name of the next-turn rider of -X (spec 6.3 Overload X, R1848004): every card that read "lose X mana next turn" or "you have X less mana next turn" prints it, and Hinder reads "Overload your opponent (X)". Speciesist, Hinder, Expedition12, Expedition123, Fortify Mind, Medina Outfitter, Core System, Secure System, Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control, Impact Reactor and Foreshadow; Jlarna repays its credit line "as Overload over your next N turns", its instalments kept in their own ledger (R1224). Wording only: no script and no number changed, and the glossary gains the Overload term in English and Chinese.
